name: Nerm Bean
desc: Legendary 'let 'em fight' energy. Has watched a man get turned into a pinata and thought 'he's still intelligently defending'. Lets a lot of shots to the back of the head slide.

name: Big Yawn McCarty
desc: The gold standard. Says 'Let's get it on!' and means it. Will stand over a KO'd fighter like a disappointed dad.

name: Mark Godawful
desc: British, stern, takes points for fence grabs like it's a personal insult to the Crown.

name: Mario Yamasnoozy
desc: Stops fights when a fighter blinks too hard. Has deducted points for 'bad vibes'. Somehow still licensed.

name: Dan Mirag-Lotta
desc: Built like a vending machine. Lets ground fights marinate for a full podcast episode before standing them up.

name: Teeth Peterson
desc: Safety first. Fans boo him every time and he does not care one bit.

name: Jason Hurtsdog
desc: So good you forget he's there, which is the point. Fighters actually like him, which is suspicious.

name: Steve Mazzaspaghetti
desc: Has been told about the KO three times. Still standing there. Allegedly asked 'is he OK?' to a man who was asleep.

name: Rusty Gaskins
desc: Regional ref who also works as a mall cop. Says 'fight!' in a whisper. Smells like menthols.

name: Adelaide Bird-Brain
desc: Has scored a round 10-8 for the guy who got knocked down twice. Watches the fight through a keyhole, apparently.

name: Cecil Peepholes
desc: Thinks leg kicks are 'not real strikes'. Scores a takedown like a nuclear launch.

name: Derek Dreary
desc: Reasonable. Boring. Correct. Nobody has ever made a meme about him.

name: Sal D'Amaretto
desc: Has judged ten thousand fights and looks like it. Gets it right more than anyone wants to admit.

name: Chris Leeway
desc: Loves forward pressure. Will give a round to a man walking into punches as long as he's walking forward.

name: Mike Ding-Dong Bell
desc: Strike counter at heart. Doesn't care about your top control, buddy.

name: Junichiro Kamijoke
desc: Quiet, precise, impossible to bribe (we checked).

name: Doug Crossbow
desc: Old-school wrestling guy. Thinks lying on someone is a love language.

name: Hometown Hal
desc: Every fighter born within 50 miles of the venue is the greatest he's ever seen.
